headline: Russia launches one of its broadest air assaults in months on Ukraine
dek: Russia launched 16 ballistic missiles and 200+ drones (incl. jet-powered Shaheds) across 11 oblasts overnight: 28 substations/energy facilities hit, 550K+ households without power, 1 killed 8 injured in Kyiv (metro station damaged), deaths in Kryvyi Rih, 6 injured/3 missing in Kyiv region.
sources: Ukraine State Emergency Service (Kyiv casualties), President Zelenskyy (Telegram/X), Russia Defense Ministry, Kyiv Independent, AA, The Times, Business Recorder, WSJ (St Petersburg terminal)

sections.what_happened: Russia launched 16 ballistic missiles and 200+ drones (incl. jet-powered Shaheds) across 11 oblasts overnight: 28 substations/energy facilities hit, 550K+ households without power, 1 killed 8 injured in Kyiv (metro station damaged), deaths in Kryvyi Rih, 6 injured/3 missing in Kyiv region. Zelenskyy claims partners gave no early warning; SecState Rubio denies any US intel-sharing pause. Trump posted he's 'in the process of negotiating peace' and would not drive Russia from the table; the Times reports Putin proposed he meet Trump and Xi next month. Separately, Ukrainian drones struck a St. Petersburg oil terminal, Ozon facility, VK data center.
sections.what_verified: AA (1 killed 8 injured Kyiv, RU MoD confirm), Kyiv Independent (28 energy facilities, 550K households), Interfax (6 injured/3 missing Kyiv region), MENAFN (3 killed 21 wounded both sides), WSJ (St Petersburg oil terminal), Times (Trump post + Putin-Xi proposal). NYT Daily reel (2.5K likes/360 comments) covers obtained RU winter-escalation plan (Kyiv/Kharkiv/Odesa, -90% electricity goal).
sections.what_disputed: Rubio denies any pause in US intel sharing with Ukraine (via TOI). Zelenskyy's air force spokesman Ihnat said warning was received before a SECOND strike but not the first; experts investigating.
sections.why_matters: The blackout campaign before winter: Russia's biggest air assault in months hits 28 energy targets as Trump claims a peace process - map of 11 oblasts, the energy math (550K homes dark), and the winter plan the NYT just obtained. US-EU diesel friction gets the debate-bait slot.
sections.context: Background: Russia launches one of its broadest air assaults in months on Ukraine: 16 ballistic missiles + 200+ drones, 28 energy facilities hit, 550K+ households blacked out; Zelenskyy 'no early warning' vs Rubio denial; Trump 'negotiating peace' post + reported Putin-Xi meeting proposal; Ukraine hit St. Petersburg oil terminal

totw_analysis: Our read: The blackout campaign before winter: Russia's biggest air assault in months hits 28 energy targets as Trump claims a peace process - map of 11 oblasts, the energy math (550K homes dark), and the winter plan the NYT just obtained. US-EU diesel friction gets the debate-bait slot. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Trump negotiating peace or pressuring Kyiv to fold? Comment fault lines: no-warning/intel-sharing dispute; 'Russia does very little to help Iran' vs US diesel-deal hypocrisy (Trump scolding Zelenskyy over RU refinery strikes hurting diesel markets).
